title: Steve Jobs Insult Response - Highest Quality
summary: A clean-audio clip from Apple's 1997 WWDC where Steve Jobs answers a hostile question from a developer about OpenDoc. He argues you must start with the customer experience and work backwards to the technology.
why: Quoted constantly as the canonical statement of product-first thinking over technology-first thinking, and as a model of handling a heckler.

quote.text: Steve Job's response is brilliant here, frankly quite timeless and ultimately (in my view) apropos.
